notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.2.150.0 Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added tutorial system that plays upon starting the game for the first time[/p][/*][*][p]Added player level and progression system![/p][/*][*][p]Added froggy thoughts! Frogs occasionally have thoughts about how they are feeling![/p][/*][*][p]Added much more feedback to explain why certain actions can not be performed[/p][/*][*][p]Added buy max packs functionality! You can now buy the max amount of packs possible in the shop and open they one after another[/p][/*][*][p]Added filtering by pond and race proficiency in frog selectors and added proficiency display to the selector buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for special frogs to breed, go to pond and race (breeding with special frogs has a slight increased chance for special offspring)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated frog lifecycle, all frogs will now start as hatchlings except frogs created from cloning which remains as the egg stage[/p][/*][*][p]Added hover sounds for buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Updated title splash to be more personalised and appear cleaner[/p][/*][*][p]Updated gold text displays on buttons to appear red when you don't have enough gold to purchase something[/p][/*][*][p]Hatchlings are now 3x as more active than adults[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tank dropdown to better show frog capacity[/p][/*][*][p]Re-added ability to purchase growth potions in demo[/p][/*][*][p]Added max multiplier for income and growth[/p][/*][*][p]Added growth and income multiplier bar displays[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled default pellet growth rate[/p][/*][*][p]Added more animations for collectables in the tank[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced 3 common pattern textures[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed clone menu error[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed frog icon bug not resetting material to default after displaying a special frog[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where frogs will occasionally not move for up to a minute or more[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.2.63.0 Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added new type of special frog, the ethereal frog![/p][/*][*][p]Added sizeable window mode option in settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to modify glass tint colour for tanks[/p][/*][*][p]Glowing frogs now have a special unlit material to make them glow even more![/p][/*][*][p]Added 1 more pattern and 1 more body for frogs[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced all environment effects so they are higher quality and have an outline[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled resolution of all backgrounds so they should appear less blurry[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed colour discovery bug that caused a variety of issues including the incorrect display of colour discovery progress in Ribbidex menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing transition effects when pressing return from the pond or racing[/p][/*][*][p]Various balancing changes[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly improved demo based on feedback, the whole demo experience should better show off the game in a much quicker fashion[/p][/*][*][p]Minor UI and tooltip improvements across many UI elements[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.2.29.0 Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Complete overhaul of UI overlays, which now include custom image icons, outlines and overall massive improvements to readability and usage[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tank environment, tanks now have a little glass border around the top edges to improve the feeling of the frogs being in a tank![/p][/*][*][p]Added tank glass tapping which scares the frogs and causes them to jump[/p][/*][*][p]Improved card backs and added selection outline[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to reveal all cards for packs and discoveries (for those wanting to speed things up)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved menus so that titles are larger and contrast better[/p][/*][*][p]Added frog locking system, lock your favourite frogs so that they cannot be sold until unlocked![/p][/*][*][p]Added breeding flagging, so that frogs that are the result of breeding now have a little icon showing so in the frog menu[/p][/*][*][p]Improved pack splash background to allow for quicker selected after closing a pack[/p][/*][*][p]Removed mutations in the demo (sorry!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added save button in settings[/p][/*][*][p]Updated pond generation to hopefully produce less ponds where your frog can't hop around enough of the map[/p][/*][*][p]Pond generation is now affected by the frog's star rating (the higher the rating, the more lily pads that spawn, with a max of 10 extra)[/p][/*][*][p]Added particles in the pond that display based on the success of breeding with a pond frog[/p][/*][*][p]Added handle to prevent pond frogs from jumping to lily pads they are already on[/p][/*][*][p]Added confirmation for returning to the tank when in the pond or racing (Decreases the chance of accidently clicking return and being sent back)[/p][/*][*][p]Added language support for German[/p][/*][*][p]Added more sound spamming handles for cards[/p][/*][*][p]Improved race environment[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced race UI with a single unified results menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added race timer UI display[/p][/*][*][p]Added frog trails to racing (colour determined by primary colour of frog)[/p][/*][*][p]Added worldwide leaderboard for fastest player frog times[/p][/*][*][p]Race frogs now sleep after finishing a race (aww)[/p][/*][*][p]Added display for decoration capacity, pellet growth, income modifier and growth modifier in tank UI (no longer requires you to open the tank menu every time to view these stats)[/p][/*][*][p]Removed redundant information display in tank menu and doubled the width of the frog selector to better view all frogs in the tank[/p][/*][*][p]Added quick selling for frog selector in tank menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added more tooltips where clarification was necessary[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed growth multiplier bug that caused the first tank's growth multiplier to be applied to all tanks and not the respective growth multiplier for each tank[/p][/*][*][p]Overall decrease in cost for all frog actions of about 10% (breeding, pond and racing)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased capped income claiming from 30k to 50k[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.457.0 Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Greatly improved special frog (gold and cosmic) appearance so they appear more special![/p][/*][*][p]Greatly improved both the frog and decoration menu[/p][/*][*][p]Improved glowing frog functionality so that special frogs glow their colour and all glowing frogs now glow as eggs too[/p][/*][*][p]Added new pellet feeding animations to make feeding feel more fun![/p][/*][*][p]Added more rarity-based UI colours to give frogs more flavour[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced outline system, the new system looks almost the same but is far more performant and reliable[/p][/*][*][p]Added outline selection system for frogs and decorations when selected[/p][/*][*][p]Added star rating system for frogs to more easily understand what frogs are good at what[/p][/*][*][p]Updated background shop buttons and added background colour selector to background tab in shop for easier use[/p][/*][*][p]Updated pond generation and visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Updated milestone reward icons[/p][/*][*][p]Updated colour selector so that the selected colour can be seen easier[/p][/*][*][p]Updated clearable appearance[/p][/*][*][p]Updated frog breeding in the tank so that the offspring are born with stats influenced from both parents[/p][/*][*][p]Updated race rewards so winnings grants more race attributes[/p][/*][*][p]Updated rarity colour accents[/p][/*][*][p]Updated decoration placing[/p][/*][*][p]Updated origin icon so that it always displays the origin and is not overridden by special frogs[/p][/*][*][p]Added locked UI to leaderboard rankings in demo[/p][/*][*][p]Increased growth potion pack of 3 from 250 to 1500[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where you could buy potions when you did not have enough gold[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sound spam when selling all frogs or decorations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rarity icon displaying incorrect information for secondary colour attribute on cards[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed race rewards bug which allowed you to claim a pack when not first in the race[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.390.0 Hotfix
notes.content: [list][*][p]Updated UI resolution handling (this should hopefully stop inconsistent text sizes across different monitor/screen resolutions)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated credits[/p][/*][*][p]Added text explanation for cloning in cloning menu[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.384.0 Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added Cosmic frogs which are even rarer than Golden frogs[/p][/*][*][p]Added milestone system with 13 milestones to unlock, when completed they unlock either a background or a decoration in the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Added world leaderboard for discovered combinations (for those who are competitive)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new collection button which shows total attribute and special collection progress[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to purchase growth potions from the shop in groups of 3[/p][/*][*][p]Added feedback button to settings menu (feedback always welcome and encouraged!)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed achievement 10 not being possible[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed frogs growing far too quickly when leaving the game running for a while and switching tanks rapidly[/p][/*][*][p]Updated unknown icon to stand out more[/p][/*][*][p]Added Korean and Portuguese (Brazil) support[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed colour changing UI not working after being disabled and then enabled[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced some ugly patterns (Tell me which other ugly ones you want me to replace!)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localisation for some patterns[/p][/*][*][p]More behind the scenes work on the demo (coming VERY soon!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]We now have a dedicated subreddit to discuss all things froggy:[/h3][p][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/RibbitRanch/"]https://www.reddit.com/r/RibbitRanch/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.350.0 Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added outline to most 2D sprites[/p][/*][*][p]Significant UI improvements across many areas[/p][/*][*][p]Added simplified Chinese and Japanese support[/p][/*][*][p]Increased tank max capacity from 35 to 45[/p][/*][*][p]Reverted to single looping soundtrack system[/p][/*][*][p]Updated breeding visualiser so that undiscovered combinations appear as unknown[/p][/*][*][p]Improved collection menu so that attributes provide a lot more information[/p][/*][*][p]Added 4 more tank lights[/p][/*][*][p]Added possibility for multiple frogs as rewards in racing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed frog prints sizing to match new frog scale[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.297.0 Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Decreased frog scale by 25% (They should appear smaller and cuter now)[/p][/*][*][p]Added tank light system, where different colour lights can be purchased from the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to turn tank light off and on[/p][/*][*][p]Updated frog colours so that 15 colours now emit a glow when dark (try turning off the tank light!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added glow icon to frog menu to show when a frog has glowing attributes[/p][/*][*][p]Removed frog token system, frog rewards (from racing or the pond) will now be automatically redeemed upon returning to the tank[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced 4 decorations[/p][/*][*][p]Added localisation system[/p][/*][*][p]Added Russian support (more languages to come!)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI to provide more information in some areas[/p][/*][*][p]Improved card backs[/p][/*][*][p]Added hover animations for cards[/p][/*][*][p]Added more UI sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Add more UI animations[/p][/*][*][p]Improved frog jump animation[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of behind the scenes demo functionality (demo on the way!)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.235.0 Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added jump animations for hatchling frogs![/p][/*][*][p]Greatly improved frog movement, frogs no longer have to turn before leaping and should feed on pellets a lot quicker now[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added spawn animation for frogs[/p][/*][*][p]Frogs now spawn in as each card is flipped, not all at once[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced most decorations with much nicer looking versions[/p][/*][*][p]Added effects for certain decorations that play when a frog lands on them[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased max decoration amount from 40 to 12[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked all decoration multipliers to either apply an income or growth bonus, not both[/p][/*][*][p]Updated shop so that it shows when the max amount of decorations have been bought for this tank[/p][/*][*][p]Added multiplier bonus display for decorations in shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shop menu bug allowing you to buy more than the maximum amount of tanks[/p][/*][*][p]Updated unknown icon for frogs so that the origin can also be seen in the corner[/p][/*][*][p]Added more UI sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Reverted pellet feeding to only apply to the frog that consumes it and not the entire tank[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hopping in the pond[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hopping speed when racing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed error when attempting to open the clone menu when no frogs have been discovered[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed discovery pop up bug appearing when a frog in another tank has been discovered[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.187.0 Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added jump animations for frogs![/p][/*][*][p]Added eye closing for all current frog bodies[/p][/*][*][p]Added golden frogs! Every time you flip a card, it has a small chance of being an ultra rare golden variant of that body type, collect them all![/p][/*][*][p]Added sleeping mechanic for frogs, where completing actions such as going to the pond, racing or breeding will cause the frog to sleep for an hour. While sleeping, further actions with the same frog are not possible[/p][/*][*][p]Added frog cloning, where discovered combinations of frog attributes can be cloned for a price, this allows you to clone (almost) every frog you have discovered[/p][/*][*][p]Updated pond frog offspring to be eggs[/p][/*][*][p]Updated pond breeding menu to display more information about the target pond frog[/p][/*][*][p]Heavily improved the visuals and effects at the pond[/p][/*][*][p]Improved attribute generation for pond frogs which should result in pond frogs having more pond attributes[/p][/*][*][p]Added placement medal effects for frogs as they finish in a race[/p][/*][*][p]Added more effects to clearables[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed double entry free for racing[/p][/*][*][p]Added more UI clearing between scenes[/p][/*][*][p]Updated pack visuals for unique origins[/p][/*][*][p]Updated pellet sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced pellet upgrade cost calculation, (now takes into account other tanks)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tooltips[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed overflow bug on high amount of potions[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]
